text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a strong five-day rally that has recovered most of a two-week loss. The bounce aligns with crude oil prices holding in the upper $89–$92 range, which supports exploration and production companies' cash flow and profitability. The stock has gained nearly 6% since November 6, suggesting investors are repositioning into the energy sector as oil stabilizes after earlier weakness.

The broader backdrop includes elevated heating oil prices—up 59% year-over-year—which signals sustained demand for refined petroleum products heading into winter, a tailwind for integrated oil companies with refining operations. This seasonal strength, combined with stable crude prices, appears to be supporting the sector's near-term outlook.
